title: Assignments reference groups that no longer exist

messages.businessImpact: The assignment is broken and the policy reaches nobody through it. Nothing in the console flags this, so the object simply appears to be deployed.
remediation: Remove the broken assignments and retarget to a group that exists.
messages.cannotSee: An assignment naming a group this run could not read is not reported, because a group nobody could read is not a group that has been deleted. The two built-in targets name no group and cannot be broken, so they are passed over.
